mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in UNRATE suggests labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE alongside falling PAYEMS indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS during a tightening cycle may slow economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing INDPRO suggests strong supply and production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above a certain threshold indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is high but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong HOUST and RSAFS indicate high demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS are strong but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 25% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High UNRATE during late-cycle expansion may not indicate weakness, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is high but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of late-cycle cases.
